reading: Kidney disease codes are entered during consultations, while laboratory results arrive separately and are never compared with the problem list. Missed codes (low sensitivity) and doubtful codes after a single low result during acute illness (low positive predictive value) are different failures with different harms. Payment incentives move register size without moving kidney function. The recorded search found nothing, so every evidence node is an unchecked lead and the local records are the only way to measure accuracy here.
